name: Sphere
summary: Sphere handles monitoring, registration, calculation, filing and remittance for sales tax, VAT and GST across more than 130 jurisdictions. Its self-serve Starter plan costs $100 per region per month for fewer than 10 regions and includes up to 50,000 calculated transactions, while larger footprints are quoted.

facts.text: Sphere says it charges a flat rate per region per month with no implementation fees or one-off costs.
The Growth plan, for 10 or more regions, adds a dedicated account manager, an on-demand tax team, 24/7 Slack support and back tax calculations.
Input tax and e-invoicing are add-ons available on request, with no price listed.
Sphere's homepage does not mention SOC 2 or ISO certification.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: For fewer than 10 regions, self-serve. Calculation up to 50,000 transactions
